# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues, pull requests,
or discussions. Open a private report through the repository's
[security advisory form](https://github.com/Roblis0n/Bertopic-tuning/security/advisories/new)
instead. Include the affected file or command, impact, reproduction steps, and
a minimal privacy-safe proof of concept.

Do not attach sensitive corpora, participant text, credentials, access tokens,
or confidential research materials. Redact the report or replace data with a
synthetic fixture that preserves the relevant behavior.

Maintainers will acknowledge receipt, assess the report, coordinate a fix when
needed, and publish disclosure information after users can safely act on it.

## Scope

The repository's Python scripts, workflow files, documentation examples, and
distributed skill metadata are in scope. Questions about methods, model
interpretation, or ordinary usage belong in [Support](SUPPORT.md), not a
security report.
